description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for the downloads root screen in an OTT platform app. It manages displaying and interacting with download items, including pause/resume, delete actions, and UI updates based on download progress.

classes.name: DownloadsRootScreen
classes.description: Main widget for the downloads screen, displaying list of download items with control actions.

classes.name: _QueueBanner
classes.description: Displays a banner indicating whether downloads are paused or running.

classes.name: _EmptyDownloads
classes.description: Displays a UI indicating there are no downloads.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for DownloadsRootScreen, rendering the download list and controls based on current DownloadController state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for _QueueBanner, showing a message depending on paused state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for _EmptyDownloads, showing a message when no downloads exist.
